sections.text: Good morning. This quarter our input costs increased approximately 12% due to global steel tariffs. We have been working closely with our primary raw material supplier, Midwest Steel Supply, who has been a reliable partner for over a decade. Despite these headwinds, we maintained production levels across all facilities.
Sarah: Can you quantify the cost impact? John: The 12% increase in steel costs translated to roughly $4M in additional expenses this quarter.
